name: workers-free
notes: Daily limits are shared account allowances; this tool projects one configured workload.
External fetch wrapper counts calls, not hidden redirect hops; partial coverage.
Local wall-clock latency is not CPU time. CPU enforcement includes runtime nuances.
D1 batch counts as one invocation query; rows and statement executions remain separately accounted.
Analytics Engine optional reference: 100000 points/day, 10000 reads/day; no remote querying implemented.
KV same-key writes: 1/second. Bulk reads count keys for daily reads, one invocation service request.
